g.text: Down Home Creole · Phase 1 · P1-412 Bench spindle capper (built in house) · rev B
UNLESS NOTED: LINEAR ±0.5 [±.02] · HOLES +0.2/-0 · ANGLES ±0.5° · MACHINED X.X ±0.1, X.XX ±0.05 · THIRD-ANGLE PROJECTION · BREAK EDGES 0.5 · ASME Y14.5

svg.text: orange = parts added in that step; ghosted = parts still to come
base flat on the bench (no rock); column plumb 0.5 / 600 both ways
block runs the full rail with no tight spot; rail straight 0.05 / 500 (dial on the block)
carriage rises to the top by itself and stops on the spring end of stroke
H4 x4 10-32 3 N·m; H12 x5 M6 4 N·m (adapter screw no Loctite)
chuck face run-out ≤ 0.1 TIR; adapter slides 12 on the spigot and springs back
H5 x3 M5 3 N·m (PC: no more)
guard clears the chuck 19 all round; no gap > 6 at the bottom edge with a jar in place
H9 8 N·m (thread only); H10 x2 M8 12 N·m
lever swings free; carriage reaches the stop rod with the lever 1-2° above its lowest
H6 x2 M8 10 N·m; H7 x8 M6 8 N·m
pad centres the jar in the V within 0.5; container upright
H13 x2 M6 3 N·m; H14 x2 M4 2 N·m
B1 operates with the carriage within 5 of the top; < 0.1 Ω PE; ITP T12-T16
1. Base weldment 100 on the bench TBL-1 at the marked position, column at the back; 4 bolts through the bench top.

2. Rail MGN15 on the seat bar 106, pushed against the reference edge, bolts from the middle out. Block on the rail (keep the retainer until the rail is in). Gas spring base bracket 505 on the base; stop rod 503 screwed into hole D with jam nuts under and over;
3. Carriage weldment 200 on the block (face B to the block); gas spring between bracket 505 and the shelf ball stud (rod end up).
4. Gearmotor P1-422 on the shelf, shaft down through Ø30 H8; clutch on the motor shaft; stub shaft 301 in the clutch; chuck adapter 302 + float spring on the spigot; urethane insert J or S.
5. Guard 303 on 3 standoffs 304 under the shelf.
6. Lever 501 in the clevis with the shoulder bolt and 2 nylon washers; link 502 with rod ends between the lever pin and the carriage lug 204; knob on the lever.
7. Nest plate 401 and V-block 402 at setting J (or S) with 2 countersunk screws; toggle bracket 404 and toggle clamp P1-450; pad 403 on the spindle thread.
8. Controls P1-451 at the front-left (2 screws through the box floor), drive A1 inside; limit switch P1-452 on the column (rivnuts); cables W0-W2 per E01.

1. Changeover shaker ↔ jar (about 5 min, plug pulled): move the V-block to its S or J holes (2 screws); swap the urethane insert (3 set screws); flip the stop block 504 up (shaker) or down (jar); set the clutch torque.
2. Clutch torque: shaker 1.6 N·m [14 lbf·in], jar 2.5 N·m [22 lbf·in]. Set on the clutch scale, cap 10 containers, check each with the torque tester P1-402 (ITP T19), adjust.

3. Each cycle: stand the container in the V, push the toggle clamp (left hand), pull the lever (right hand) until the stop, hold about 1 s after the clutch slips, release, pull the clamp back, remove.
4. Cleaning: wipe down only (no product contact with caps on). Remove the insert weekly and wash it. Do not hose the controls box.
5. Lubrication: MGN block has a seal and a reservoir: grease every 6 months through the nipple (NSF H1). Check the gas spring force yearly (carriage must rise on its own).
HARDWARE AND TORQUES (all A2 stainless; full spec on 800)
Hex bolt M8 x 30 A2-70 + 2 washers + nyloc
Socket cap screw M3 x 16 A2-70
Socket cap screw M3 x 12 A2-70 + Loctite 243
Pan screw 10-32 x 1/2 in 18-8 + split washer
Socket cap screw M5 x 25 A2 through standoffs 304
V-block 402 through nest 401 into base (S or J holes)
Socket cap screw M6 x 16 A2
toggle bracket 404 to base (4), toggle clamp to bracket (4)
Socket cap screw M8 x 16 A2
Shoulder bolt Ø10 x 20 (M8) A2 + nyloc + 2 nylon washers
Socket cap screw M8 x 25 A2 + nyloc
rod ends to lug 204 and lever 501
Hex jam nut M16 x 1.5 A2
stop rod 503 under and over the base
Set screw M6 x 8 A2 cup point
clutch hubs on motor shaft and stub (2 + 2), chuck adapter on stub spi
Socket cap screw M6 x 16 A2 + bonded sealing washer
enclosure bottom end wall to base (inside the box)
Socket cap screw M4 x 10 A2
limit switch to the column left face (2 x M4 rivnut)
